The company announced Tuesday that veteran media and technology executive Marc DeBevoise has been appointed Chief Executive Officer. DeBevoise succeeds company founder Steve Potash, who is transitioning to Chairman of the Board after 40 years leading the organization. The leadership change represents a carefully planned succession strategy designed to scale OverDrive's digital platform and accelerate its international footprint. Potash, who founded the company four decades ago, successfully guided OverDrive from the early days of digital content experimentation into a global infrastructure mainstay. Today, the platform serves educational and public institutions in more than 115 countries. Mar 04, 2026 · Digital content provider OverDrive announced on March 3 that it has brought in Marc DeBevoise as its new president. DeBevoise, former CEO at the video platform Brightcove and a past leader at the online content network CBS Interactive, will help guide the company known for library reading app Libby, school “science of reading app” Sora, and video-streaming app Kanopy. OverDrive founder and CEO Steve Potash, who served as company president prior to DeBevoise’s appointment, said in a statement that he expects DeBevoise to “make Libby, Sora, and Kanopy even more user friendly, more inclusive, and more joyful to use” and “help libraries and schools do what they do best, change lives through reading, viewing, and learning.” Potash and DeBevoise now will work together with the OverDrive leadership team.
